Subject: Post-discovery: Align demo slots & evaluation kickoff charter

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today. Quick recap (so weall have the same expectations):

- Primary use case: customer support ticket summarization + multi-agent routing for triage.
- Key constraints: PII-sanitized logs, sub-200ms soft latency target on short responses, and a pilot dataset of ~50k tickets.
- Success metrics you care about: F1 on intent classification >= 0.88, average summary ROUGE-L delta vs. baseline < -5%, and integration turnaround within 2 sprints.

Next step we agreed on: schedule the evaluation kickoff (trial plan + prompt set/evals + tech deep dive). To make that meeting efficient Ive attached a one-page mutual action plan and a starter prompt pack. Proposed agenda:

1) Confirm trial scope & timeline (what subset of traffic, test accounts, observation windows)
2) Define success criteria & acceptance tests (metric thresholds, sample prompts)
3) Share prompt set & evaluation harness (how well run regressions and measure quality)
4) Tech deep dive for integration touchpoints (auth, data flow, security checklist)

Proposed 45-60m slots next week (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-13 09:00-10:00
- Tue 2026-10-13 14:00-15:00
- Wed 2026-10-14 11:00-12:00

Can you confirm which works best and who from your side will attend (PM, Eng, Security, Procurement)? Also: would Procurement like to join just the kickoff or a separate procurement/contract sync?

Attachments: AveryTech-MAP-draft.pdf (mutual action plan)

If those slots don't fit, we can suggest alternate windows. Ill loop in Rishi and Marissa internally to make sure we bring security and the right SWEs.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
